title: GenAI & LLM Engineer
jobDescription: We are seeking a specialist dedicated to designing, testing, and optimizing agentic AI solutions and sophisticated workflows. The role centres on engineering high-reliability prompts using techniques like Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and React, while building robust RAG pipelines grounded by knowledge graphs and ontologies. The ideal candidate is proficient in the modern AI ecosystem, including LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere), orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph, and vector databases like Pinecone or FAISS. Beyond development, you will be responsible for multi-agent orchestration and implementing rigorous evaluation frameworks like HELM and RAGAS to ensure accuracy. A successful hire will combine technical mastery of embeddings and fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT) with the creativity and clear writing skills necessary to drive experimentation in a fast-paced environment.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobDescription: This role focuses on the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of ML and GenAI models for customer-facing solutions and platform components. The core responsibilities involve transitioning ML models from prototype to production while optimising foundation models for domain-specific applications through fine-tuning and quantisation. You must possess deep expertise in traditional ML algorithms, feature engineering, and advanced deep learning architectures, including Transformers and Attention mechanisms. Proficiency in Python and frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and HuggingFace is essential, alongside a strong grasp of model optimisation tools like ONNX or TensorRT. Additionally, the position requires a commitment to ethical AI principles and interpretability using SHAP or LIME, ensuring all solutions are scalable, high-performing, and rigorously validated through A/B testing.

title: Technical Project Manager - BSS/OSS
jobDescription: This role involves end-to-end project ownership and delivery of large-scale BSS/OSS transformation programmes. Key responsibilities include leading cross-functional teams of up to 50 members, managing detailed project plans, budgets, and resource allocation across the full lifecycle from requirements to rollout. The position requires a strong technical grounding in telecom systems such as Billing, CRM, and Order Management, alongside expertise in governance, RAID management, and multi-vendor coordination. A successful candidate will drive technical discussions with architects, manage intensive client interactions at the executive level, and ensure quality through rigorous SIT/UAT readiness and release planning.

title: Finance Professional
jobDescription: This role is responsible for the end-to-end preparation of standalone and consolidated financial statements in compliance with Indian GAAP on a quarterly and annual basis. Key duties include managing statutory and tax audit processes, coordinating with auditors, and ensuring meticulous documentation and compliance. The position oversees the verification of various GST filings (GSTR 2B, 3B, 9, and 9C), TDS/TCS returns, and the approval of entries within Tally for both Indian and subsidiary books. Additionally, the role involves performing detailed monthly analyses of profit and loss statements, cash flows, and provisions, alongside maintaining fixed asset registers and stock statements. A successful candidate will take the lead in preparing tax and transfer pricing returns, liaising with tax auditors, and directly representing the company in responding to tax and GST queries with government officers.

title: Delivery Director - Telecom (BSS/OSS)
jobDescription: This leadership role is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of large, complex telecom transformation programmes with a specific focus on Billing and Revenue Management (BRM). The director owns programmes execution, financial P&L performance, and customer governance across multi-geo engagements, operating frequently at the CXO level. Core responsibilities include driving delivery excellence through standard processes, managing financial risks like cost overruns, and fostering a culture of accountability across cross-functional teams. The position also demands strategic partnership with Sales for account mining and new deal estimations, as well as a strong focus on talent development, workforce planning, and attrition management within the telecom practice.

title: Account Manager
jobDescription: The Account Manager leads end-to-end delivery management for application development projects, ensuring they adhere to timelines, budgets, and quality standards. This role requires a client-focused mindset to understand business objectives and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Responsibilities include managing and motivating teams of developers, testers, and SMEs, as well as identifying and qualifying new sales opportunities based on market trends and competitor offerings. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in sales and solution leadership, collaborating with internal engineering and product teams to deliver comprehensive customer proposals and improve overall sales performance.

title: Oracle BRM Developer
jobDescription: This technical role focuses on the design, development, and maintenance of Oracle BRM configurations and customisations, specifically within the telecom or utilities domain. The developer is responsible for working with Product Catalogue, Pricing Centre, and Pipeline Manager to implement billing workflows and revenue management processes. Essential tasks include developing custom opcodes using C/C++ or Java and integrating BRM with external systems like CRM and Middleware. The candidate must possess a deep understanding of the BRM architecture and data model, providing production support, troubleshooting issues, and participating in system upgrades and patching activities in a Unix/Linux environment.

title: BSS Architect/Effort Estimator
jobDescription: This architect-level position requires deep domain expertise in BSS/OSS and extensive knowledge of OBRM products, including ECE and PDC. A key focus of the role is effort estimation for RFPs, requiring the ability to decompose complex requirements and collaborate with Sales and Pre-Sales teams during bid defence. The candidate must have a proven track record of driving PoCs for complex solutions and acting as an architect in major billing transformation projects. Responsibilities also include leading requirement discovery workshops and providing high-level technical guidance across CRM and OSS products like Siebel, OSM, and UIM, while ensuring alignment with industry standard frameworks like TMF FrameworX and TOGAF.

title: Java Developer
jobDescription: This role is focused on supporting a Billing and Revenue Management (BRM) upgrade initiative through Java version upgrades, framework compatibility remediation, and application refactoring. The developer will be responsible for migrating applications to newer Java versions, such as Java 11 or 17, while analysing and fixing deprecated APIs and breaking changes. Key technical duties include working on Java-based integrations with Oracle BRM using PCM APIs and custom extensions, as well as modifying components that interact with billing pipelines and invoicing flows. A successful candidate must demonstrate deep expertise in the JVM, multithreading, and Spring Boot, alongside the ability to resolve complex version conflicts in Maven or Gradle. Additionally, the role involves updating build pipelines and ensuring the stability of custom Java utilities and batch jobs throughout the upgrade lifecycle.
